Location credits

Original procedural geometry and textures. Photographs were used as visual references; their pixels are not included in the game.

Times Square · New York

Illuminated tower, stacked displays, plaza steps and avenue streetscape. Reference: Times Square looking south from 46th Street, Dough4872, 2019. CC BY-SA 4.0.

SoHo · New York

Cast-iron columns, cornices, tall windows, fire escapes and storefronts. Reference: 102 Greene Street, Beyond My Ken. CC BY-SA 4.0.

Shibuya · Tokyo

Scramble crosswalks, commercial towers and dense signs. Reference: Shibuya Crossing, 2019-09-05, Sergiy Galyonkin. CC BY-SA 2.0.

Accuracy and reuse

These are recognizable arcade interpretations, not surveyed replicas. Building proportions, signs, distances and street connections are simplified or invented. Each location is a repeating driving corridor; scenic side streets are not a navigable city map. No Google Maps or Street View imagery, API, tracing or data is used.

The original location artwork and procedural scene source in locations.js are released under CC BY-SA 4.0, credited to sormazi / NightView. Vendored Three.js retains its MIT license.
